reviews.text:
Numbered Headings for Confluence has become a very useful addition in organizing and managing large documentation spaces. In environments with extensive and structured content, maintaining clear hierarchy and navigation is essential—and this app does it extremely well.
Before using this add-on, managing heading structures across complex Confluence pages was inconsistent and required manual effort. With Numbered Headings, everything becomes standardized automatically, making documents easier to follow, reference, and maintain.
What used to be a small but persistent challenge is now solved seaml
Amazing support from the Appfire team!

I needed a way to solve for my issue with product and the support team responded immediately. The quick service and correct answers are encouraging to see as the team delivered exactly what was needed and in a timely fashion. Thanks for being there when needed!

We recently reached out to the AppFire support team regarding a problem with the Numbered Headings plugin. The team was very responsive in providing us with a beta fix version of the plugin to do testing in non-prod, and then were able to quickly follow up with the final released version in the Atlassian Marketplace. Their prompt response and solution was very much appreciated! Great support team.

We recently reached out to Appfire's support team regarding an issue with the Numbered Headings plugin in Confluence. The support team was responsive and able to identify the root cause of the problem and provided a solution that worked effectively.

I recently reached out to Appfire's support team regarding an issue with the Numbered Headings plugin in Confluence. The support team was responsive and provided timely assistance throughout the process, able to identify the root cause of the problem and provided a solution that worked effectively.
Numbered Headings gives our Confluence a nice and structured possibility to display documentations and policies.

After more than six months of use:
- after getting used to the necessary macro to put the text into in order to have them numbered, it is working not more than fair. Main disadvantage is that during edit you DO NOT see the numbering. 
Support respons is under par: discovered bugs are not fixed after addressing them at support: 
(1) the use of arrow keys have annoying navigation effects
(2) strange diacritical characters appear after publishing (fixed :-))
(3) Popups after every publication of your page

Completely useless.  The "documentation" says that you add the content you wish numbered to the macro BUT there is no way to do this.  When you add the macro to a page it covers your content with a macro options menu and then that's it.  The menu can't be gotten rid of and there's no way to type or cut-and-paste content into the macro.

This app is nice to have and wanted to thank the support team for their quick attention on a case I logged recently, the turnaround time and the resolution they provided for the issue that we were facing is greatly appreciated. Keep up the good work.
The app is easy to use, makes our documentation job easier.
We have the paid version...but not for long. Awkward, awful, doc is worse. Doesn't accept Confluence comments, etc.

It works OK and provides the minimal features for the required function.
But for this kind of trivial addon it is *at least* 10x overpriced. We have a small tool here that also requires very, very little development and maintenance.

I needed something that included the page, not just the headings on the page. Think requirements list and traceability matrix. Each Confluence page is its own requirement. We then need to export the pages out for our clients and make sure the numbering goes with it.

It does what it says on the tin with regard to numbering; however, since we upgraded and moved from on-prem Confluence to Cloud, some other macros (notably the /code macro) do not work correctly within the Numbered Headings block.  This is a big issue for us as most of what we are making pages for revolves around code snippets.
Nice little helper for structured content in Confluence.

Would it be possible to get a custom version of Numbered Headings in which it always defaults to the following, and the only option is on or off?
* Number format: ISO 2145
* Starting number: 1
* Starting heading: H1
* Skip headings: <none>

Breaks 'copy link to heading' feature when you hover mouse over the heading. ToC is loading longer after using this plugin. It should be a built-in feature in Confluence, not something we need a paid plugin for which even has some issues.
can not see the button in toolbar?

Nice tool ! Works as expected except for the Starting number where the format given in the documentation "4,1,3" does not work. I would have expected my page to starting counting heading #4 at 4.1.3.1 which is not working and results to 1.1.1.1 as if the entry is refused. That's the only reason why I give a 4 stars instead of a 5.

Numbered Headings advertises some basic functionality to be free. That is the only reason why we agreed to install the free app in our instance. What it did not advertise that it was asking users to nag us to upgrade to the "Pro" version. Very bad behaviour that is! We will try to get rid of this as soon as possible :(
Atlassian should remove WYSIWYG editor and let third party vendor to provide it as a marketplace app and charge 1$ per user.
Solid, does what it says. Makes life a little easier. Wish it extended into tables but good translation of H1, Hn headers into somewhat better organized than native Confluence editor.
Price raised, we can not use it anymore.

I simply reported a bug, and support reached out to me within 24 hours and resolved my issue.
Very fast and efficient support.

Very nice app not only for laborious writers ;-) 
We just head a little issue and the support of Avisi / Maarten Arts was uncredible fast and effective!
Thanks a lot for the App and espeically the perfect support!
Avisi created a small but very helpful plug-in. The support was dedicated to help as soon as possible. All-in-all it is a pleasant experience to work with Avisi.

I contacted Avisi support about a problem their plug-in had when interacting with a different plug-in (not from Avisi). They promptly fixed the issue and released a new version. Thanks for the quick help!
Very fast support! Thank you guys!
Useful Add-on which work's as aspected. Very fast and nice support.

We use NH since 2012 for free, now new commercial Pro version is also available.
I've just used "Paid update" option, version was updated, and now trial version of Pro is available for download.
All the functions of "old" free add-on work nice as before, thanks to authors for keeping our pages alive.
Sorry for my first emotional [and fully incorrect] review! ))

About support: We had a some trouble licensing this (and a 3rd party-) plugin with the Atlassian plugin Manager. A few minutes after  ticket-opening the issue was discussed and fixed in an interactive chat. 
Support at it's best - great Job!

It is a bit frustrating when you cannot buy the pro version and the free version comes with no option anymore.
We have  been using Numbered heading since the beginning and actually, 2234 pages have numbered headings which proove that this plugin is a winning one.

In our useCase, we never use numbered heading for h1 paragraphs. So now we cannot do this anymore, sad.

it is still a lot usable with no option, but we would be very grateful if the option to select the min level will still be part of the free version.

Michael

This little plugin is a great help, thanks Avisi!
If possible, please add a new feature to this plugin to force new versions of a document to be saved with a comment while still allowing drafts.

Thanks for the plugin. Good job!
Is it possible numerate text inside headers (as option)? It's a usefull thing for analysts, also it makes text more structured.
Great Plugin and great support!

name: (AI powered) Automated Release Notes & Reports for Jira

reviews.text: “Using ARNR has been a game-changer for our team! It has automated our release notes/reporting process, and saved us lot of time ! The customisation and flexibility is incredibly useful, and the integration with Jira is seamless. The support team has been helpful, which made the overall experience even better. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to simplify RN process !”

Highly Recommended for Creating Professional Release Notes

This application is very easy to use and delivers truly professional-quality release notes with minimal effort. One of its standout features is the seamless JQL integration, which allows users to automatically fetch issues based on specific criteria—saving significant time and manual effort.

The flexibility to include custom fields in the release notes is another major advantage, enabling teams to tailor outputs to their exact needs. What makes this app even more valuable is its ability to generate polished release notes directly fro

Before using this tool I had a lot of overhead creating the pages and chasing product owners to ensure they added their notes and the tone was consistent. Since using ARN we have a much slicker process, the AI means the tone is consistent, everything looks more professional and we can now easily communicate bespoke information to our global user base in a way we couldn't before. 

In addition to this the support has been fantastic, whenever we have encountered issues the team are quick to respond and help me resolve the problem.

Before using ARN our customer release notification process was fragmented in ownership, inconsistent in format, variable in quality, and sometimes late.  That has all changed with ARN.

Now, with very little additional overhead from our teams that were already using Jira, we are generating release notes to internal business users through Slack, Email, and Confluence pages, and providing general customers with release notes via JSM, and specialist customers with dedicated and secure Release Pages.

I find this app quite useful. We use it to produce release notes for our public documentation, and also to produce internal "recaps" which help everyone keep up on what's been done and what's happening in the next sprint.
Very useful to simplify RN generation. Quite powerful and flexible. Support team is quick. I even received a video demonstration for one of my how-to questions. Recommended.

This tool is a godsend when you want to build release notes with information from multiple custom fields in Jira.

We generate release notes as Confluence pages, with the built-in templates we can represent them in a table or sequential layout and choose how to group and sort them.  We still manually clean up the generated page, but that is more of a data than a tool issue.

To assist our SMEs we now also use the AI generator to summarize the tickets, reducing the workload for the SME and technical writers.

If our products evolve we may also include a release note page or release widget, but

Also, brand new feature to incorporate AI to generate or refine the notes is tremendous! It saves a lot of time and effort, and you can still edit it as you like before publishing. And even if you publish anything, you still can edit and resync changes!

It may take a little tweaking to get the exact output you want, but should you not understand how to do precisely what you're looking for the Amoeboids support team is super helpful/informative and will get to the bottom of it for you!

This is a great add-on. Allows to easily map to various JIRA fields to include in with the notes, in a customizable table or sequential type page layout, allowing for further style and customization. This add-on helped to streamline our release notes process, and included just the style feature I was looking for to give the notes a nice professional look.

Our documentation team has been working with ARN for quite some time now. They were able to seamlessly integrate this plug-in into their documentation workflow thanks to ARN's extremely powerful and flexible functions. Compiling and publishing the release notes are no longer any hassle at all. Even importing the release notes into our authoring tool MadCap Flare is no problem. Excellent support, didn't waste a minute to set up the notification of the release to Slack, highly customizable and after a short demo call I have no problem reconfiguring the template to the many needs we have.

All the stars for this product. We utilize a change management process that requires our release notes to be sent to an external team for review. The Amoeboids product really streamlines this process for us and makes it as simple as clicking run on a rule to reliably distribute the email. name: PlantUML, Swagger, drawio.xml, Mermaid, Numbered Headings

reviews.text: Super fast support! Thank you Andrzej for your help.

I’d like to say a THANK YOU to the development and support team — you are amazing!
A very important change for our company was done in just one sprint, which is really impressive.

The plugin is powerful and easy to use.
It works well with PlantUML, BPMN, and OpenAPI and shows everything correctly.

The Git integration is very useful.
Now we don’t need to manually update BPMN diagrams after changes.
We simply do a "git push", and MacroPack updates everything automatically.

Overall, it’s a great plugin for a reasonable price 😉
Thanks again to the developers ❤️

The Mermaid Plugin for Confluence is a great tool for creating diagrams directly in Confluence. It supports Mermaid, PlantUML, Swagger, drawio.xml, Markdown, and HTML, making it flexible and easy to use.

Highlights:
Simple and efficient for technical documentation.
Diagrams render cleanly and look professional.
Works reliably with multiple formats.

What really stands out is the excellent support. Whenever an issue comes up, you can raise a ticket, and the support team acknowledges it quickly and works on a fix without delay. This responsiveness makes the plugin even more valuable.

Highly re

We have been using it for over a month. Very happy with the very wide range of capabilities. Every user finds how to create diagrams her preferred way!
All works very well.
The so slow to render mermaid uml diagram
There was a small issue, but the team fixed it with a light of speed! It's worth the little money!

You need to upgrade Macro Pack

I needed an app to reference my notes in markdown in out corporate confluence and stumbled upon this one. At first it was not able to reference certain markdowns, so I contacted the support and the problem was fixed in a week or so. 

Along the way the team was very helpful and responsive, a pleasant communication. I did not try all the features the app provides, but it solved my issues for sure.

Thanks again!

We started using Macro Pack recently and it has already proven to be extremely useful in our Confluence setup. Thanks to its flexibility, we were able to replace three separate plugins with Macro Pack alone, which makes our environment much easier to maintain.

The support is outstanding as well: we suggested a feature, and the developers implemented it on the very same day.

Highly recommended!
It works neatly ! I wish they could make it so by clicking on the diagram we can expand it to full screen, but I m already satisfied, thanks a lot

As many stars as possible without a doubt. I wrote a new feature request, and they released it within a month! And it's free?! 
If they can make some sort of resizing for the rendered outputs, it would be an absolute perfection. A field like width = 40%. 
But it could cause troubles on tablets and phones, but something similar.

This is super helpful for us to centralize the info of our API documentation within our internal Confluence page and it makes it easy to collaborate and further iterate on them.    

The fact that it also integrates other formats is a bonus and we'll definitely explore it more in the future.

Really a plugin that's been missing in Confluence for a long time. Finally here, helping to document your solutions in so many ways. Swagger embedded on Confluence? Not a problem! Mermaid, PlantUML? All is there. Nice and easy to use.

Of course there are still lacking features like zooming/panning, minor styling issues with PlantUML, but authors are eager to hear feedback and are already working on solutions.

Recommended to anyone willing to document IT solutions in many user-friendly ways.

Most Mermaid Diagram types are buggy :/ arrows don't work in Sequence or relationship diagrams, Gantt charts are so small, they are unreadable and minmaps overlap to a degree where they are unreadable as well! The plugin is not well-integrated. There is no preview of the diagram, making it less useful to use.

I had an issue with the !include statement of the PlantUML plugin which got quickly resolved. No I can make use of the PlantUML standardlib and create architecture diagrams directly in the Wiki code. 
Splendid, thank you!

Maintaining diagrams has become much easier with this plugin
It integrates well with confluence.

Markdown and Mermaid are great technologies for writing documentation both developers and product managers can understand and change. Being able to embed both into Confluence pages makes our workflow of documenting a whole lot easier, intuitive and non-destructive, as we can embed both new and already existing Markdown/Mermaid documentation directly into the Confluence pages and get them out of there again without any weird formatting issues or loosing the original Markdown/Mermaid code.

While it took me a while to understand how to use this plugin properly, it gets the job done pretty well!

HTML tags cause the renderer to think that there is a syntax error in my mermaid diagram.
Tested PlantUML briefly, seems to work fine.

I am currently testing/using the app for a documentation I make, and this app is great idea to centralize the source of API documentation in a familiar and easy to use Swagger interface. Unfortunately it still does not support the lates specification of OpenAPI documentation - 3.1.0. And it does not work if GitLab repo is made accessible via VPN only, but it is not a big deal.

@Devs, please note that from version 3.1.0 on the OpenAPI Initiative project has ditched the usage of semantic versioning (SemVer) when versioning the releases of OpenAPI documentation.

This system is easy to understand, works flawlessly, and integrates well. 
Embedding into Confluence pages was a breeze.

As the creator of this app I highly recommend it to all Confluence users. 
We mostly developed it because a lot of people asked us about good Swagger plugin
that integrates well with External Share for Confluence.

name: Pivot Report: Roll Up Epic Issues, Worklogs & Time in Status

reviews.text: We've recently started using Pivot Report and encountered an issue with one of our reports. We reached out to the support team, and the problem was resolved promptly. I'm very pleased with the quality of support and the quick response, both are crucial when relying on a software solution.
We had a small issue migrating from the data center to the cloud. We reached out to support and received an excellent response in under an hour.

We use the Pivot Report plugin and it made a lot Excel-reports based on manual exports from Jira obsolete. On top the team behind the Plugin delivers excellent and very fast support. 
An issue we reported was fixed very fast - great, just great!

We have been using this tool for over 3 years now and it makes our daily work easier to monitor the progress of our project teams and create relevant reports for our controlling and our partners.

The app is constantly being improved with new features and interfaces and the support team is more than helpful in case of problems.

We are more than satisfied and can only recommend the App!
This is surprisingly powerful! It was very quick to learn the basics and my reports were shown to management several times. The support team is also very fast to respond.

I was again feeling impressed with the responsiveness to my support ticket today regarding sorting of sub-tasks on Pivot report. 
"Quickest response Iâve seen from any companyâs support in a long time. Thanks!"
The responsiveness for Pivot Report support has been consistently excellent for us at New Ocean Health Solutions. 
We have been using Pivot Report with great success for several years now.

Our org uses this plugin for several different needs, including:
* Capacity planning (showing cumulative estimated hours grouped by team)
* Sprint Planning (Epic & Initiative levels)
* Daily Scrum (showing issues in Sprint grouped by Dev in one tab & by QA in another tab)
* Impediment tracking (showing issues linked using "blocked" relationship)

There are lots of little nifty things you can do with this tool, & I still learn new ways of using this as I play around with it. As several others have already mentioned, support is very responsive. I even asked them how I could display a Sprint Goal

Great tool for all sized projects because of the extra items you get above and beyond the standard Jira dashboard gadgets.  But, this tool is especially useful for large projects with thousands and thousands of tickets.  The ability to drill-down and focus on areas of interest (that you specify through configuring in the tool or via the pull-in of custom filters) is truly amazing!

Been using the app for a while now, it replaces most of the reporting I was doing using exports and excel and gives me a good view of my projects. Some functionalities could be improved here and there but overall its a great time saver well worth the investment.

Support is quick and efficient as well.
Fastest bug fix time of the Atlassian marketplace!!!

Easy to use, informative and a nice helper for our daily reviews.
Highly recommend!
By the way, they have quick and responsive support. Thanks!

loving it! We're doing our weekly recap for all teams using pivot report as we are able to view tasks on which time was tracked on in the previous week. Something you cannot find in native Jira. Also, yearly planning was great. We used the pivot view to see how much story points are due in which quarters/months. You can also add slices to see the whole department and the breakdown of the single teams. With a bit of JQL knowledge, this is an awesome app!

Excellent tool, with very responsive support team who fixed a bug I reported in no time. 
Keep up the good work!
As an Atlassian partner in India. We have seen this plugin utilized by our customers and for agile teams it is a great plugin.

The product is very powerful, easy to configure (if you follow the documentation) and builds upon existing data hierarchy in Jira (Epic, Task, Sub-task). You can even go further with higher and lower levels (e.g. Initiative, Project, or linked issues) in addition to the three levels in Jira.

I am happy with the timely and spot-on support. The team shared visual, annotated steps for me to accomplish what I was looking for. I also enjoyed the demo that you can play with.

PivotReport is a fantastic tool for mining your JIRA data with little to no effort.  We strongly recommend it for any customers that want to create sophisticated, powerful dashboards that show what is happening in your environment and what the team is tracking towards.

Every Development Manager needs to be using this tool.

Great tool, very useful especially in regards to managing budget.
The team is also very reactive and worked to create nez reports custom made for our needs.
I stongly recommend PIVOT

I reported a bug in the pivot reports and they fixed it with a 24 hour turn around.
This tool has been very useful for me in terms of cross functional progress reporting. I recommend it highly!

Great tool for reporting and planning. Hard to imagine how to plan & track multily projects without Pivot Reports. 100% trusted solution.
Easy to use. Clear and transparent. It's like swiss-knife for reporting.
Cudos to customer support!
A+ all around. Incredibly powerful and useful tool. 100% friendly and helpful support team.

It is the best app in the marketplace for us due to absolute flexibility for report creation with outstanding clarity. It comes with almost unbeatable price performance ratio as well and is topped with the fast and competent support (if needed).

We love working with Pivot Reports in our Jira server instance and cannot imagine using Jira without this app any more!

We are working for a few months with Pivot Report and find it very useful for our needs. Now it is hard to imagine how we worked without it. In terms of integration, we had a discussion with a support team and they advised how to make better tracking and what's needs to configured on the Jira side as well (Flow specific things and status mapping). And after that, we are happy using Pivot Report on a daily basis.
A+ support, I received a response with a solution within 3 minutes of emailing Colined's support address.

I started using Pivot Reports around 1 month ago, and it literally exceeds expectations in doing its job for cross-project reporting. 
First, I was combining it with another tool from the same developer - Worklogs. But after asking to implement the list of detailed worklogs to be available together with the pivot in the Pivot Report - it became available within 2 weeks. Cudos to the team for tool flexibility and responding to customer requests!

I recently started using Pivot Reports for some of my larger cross-functional programs. I was impressed with their ability to support on a feature enhancement related to slices, report performance, and to solve certain issues with dealing with certain corner cases.

This is a fantastic and powerful reporting tool - it saves a lot of time of exporting the data to Excel and creating a the pivot table there as you can slice and dice your data as you wish and save the report for reuse. Other benefits are its hierarchy integration with Advanced Roadmaps and the ability to report on custom fields when needed. Finally, the support is outstanding - very friendly and helpful.

Pivot Report is one of the most powerful value-add plug-ins/apps for Jira that I've encountered over the years. The features it provides to enable sophisticated *in-Jira* reporting, and incredibly flexibly roll-up and slicing capabilities are indispensable. This is the second company where I've leveraged Pivot Report to provide easily adaptable "Portfolio" and "Program" views of the work my engineering teams have planned and in-flight. 

It's entirely possible to provide most of that info using Excel/G.Sheets and other tools, but Pivot Report's ability to do so using live data, and exposed wit

It was my first time talking to their support team and I found it very easy to communicate with them. Their team was very effective and solved the issue I was experiencing. 

Thanks!

Great Work!

name: Released Hub – AI Release Notes, Roadmap and Feedback Portal

reviews.text:
Background: We've used Released for over a year. I had been looking for something that would spruce up release notes somewhat as we used to do one-liners and copy-paste things manually around. Don't go there - that's definitely NOT it. :)

This is also what Released solves for us. we use fixVersion and a few other fields to get the collection of tickets targeted for a specific release. The release note structure looks always identical. You can make it nice with a footer picture and some formatting. Customers can also subscribe to release notes to get them via email. The plugin itself is very u

Finally, a roadmap tool that actually lives where the work happens.
---
The Integration Reality: We originally switched to Released for its native Jira integration. My expectation was that keeping a roadmap in sync with reality should be automated, not a manual chore. Released has absolutely met this bar. Using JQL to filter exactly what we need across 10+ different Jira projects works like a charm. It eliminates the "sync errors" and manual double-entry found in other standalone roadmap apps.
---
Closing the Feedback Loop: Where Released truly pulls ahead of the competition is user communicat

Historically, writing release notes has been one of the most time consuming and least favorite tasks I handle. I put a lot of effort into manually slogging through the process and it didn't seem like our employees or customers paid attention.

Initially I was just trying to find a tool that would use AI to automate the release note draft process. When I discovered Released, it totally changed how I think about customer feedback, roadmaps, and release notes. I love the seamless integration with Jira, ability to authenticate and control access based on email address, page embed and widget codes,

​We’ve evaluated several tools, including Canny, Featurebase, and ProductPlan, and we’ve decided to move forward with Released. The main reasons were its ease of use, the ability to push rich changelogs (including videos), AI-generated release notes, and how seamlessly it reuses existing Jira tickets for the roadmap.
A great app! Publishing release notes has never been quicker or easier. The support team is also excellent.

The Released app has been a great addition to our release process. We are now able to free up our product owners time and share the load of generating release notes. Thank you Jens and the team for the help in refining our prompt to provide the information our customers were looking for.

Using Released has saved us a lot of time and effort when it comes to creating release notes for our own products. The AI powered changelog generation is genius! It can take technical details from our Jira issues and turn it into something more end-user friendly. Support for the app is great too - Jens and co. were very happy to assist me with any issues I had.

As the product owners of several marketplace apps, Released has helped us immensely in sharing our roadmap and release notes/changelog with our customers.
Rather than moving to Confluence or any other website, users are now able to access all the relevant info within the app. 
Thank you, Jens and team.
Love it!
Clean and elegant public roadmap solution, packed with many more features that have helped put a polish on our team. Keep up the great work!

We are a SAAS company using the awesome combination of:
- JIRA, JIRA Service Management & JIRA Discovery
- Confluence
- Refined
- Released

This allows us to built an awesome customers experience at help.fieldbuddy.com, including all the information that customers expect from a software company.  Our support (JSM), our documentation (Refined) and our release notes + roadmap (Released). All in a single portal.

Released creates this user-friendly layer on top of JIRA and presents it to the world, its easy to use and since we started using the AI-features we spent less time in creating our relea

This application is excellent, and the team behind it is even better. The updates have been fantastic, with consistent releases and additional features. If you're looking for the ideal release notes software to connect with your Jira environment, this is it!
Straight forward app that could bring a lot of value to a team but as we are currently looking for a roadmap visualized as a timeline it isn't the app for us.

It is a great app that provides a functionality we always missed in Jira. It is great to inform your internal stakeholders, but also external customers about what has been changed in the products and what is ahead on the roadmap. The app is well designed and easy to use. With the help of AI, changelog posts are written in minutes based on Jira issues.

An outstanding app that delivers exactly what we needed. We quickly transitioned from using it for internal release notes to making it our official "What's New" solution within weeks. It looks great, functions perfectly, and with the help of LLM/AI, it turns a traditionally painful process into a breeze. www.accoil.com/whatsnew

Released has been an incredible tool for our team to manage our Release Notes for our entire platform. It's now a core part of our release process! 

Released allows us to create templates, write notes via AI based on our actual Jira tickets, and distribute to our customers via a page or widget (or both!). It's been a huge win for our product team as we continue to improve our customer communications. 

They've also recently rolled out their public roadmap functionality (linked to JPD!), which we are eager to dive into! 

I love the simplicity of set-up and the immediate connection with alllll

I have been following Released since its initial announcement, and I am really impressed with how far it has gone already! With the new roadmap feature, we will be able to show our clients transparently what we plan, while the advanced AI features make it really cost-effective to maintain. The built-in widget feature can be embedded into our apps, so it can help us drop a tool and combine our customer-facing communication all together! Keep up the good job!

Released has made our release process so much easier! The AI-generated release notes save us tons of time, and the Jira integration works like a charm. Customizing the release notes to fit the tone of our brand works really well. Highly recommend for any team looking to streamline their release notes!

We've been using the Released for a few weeks now, and it has significantly improved communication with our customers. 

The AI-generated release notes get us 90% there, saving us a lot of time we previously spent manually writing. 

The roadmap feature is also great â we joined the beta early on. It makes it much easier to share our plans with customers without maintaining a separate roadmap outside of Jira, which was always outdated.

Lastly, the Released team has been exceptionally responsive to our feedback, which is really great to see.
I wish it would auto-send to slack. Other than that it has been really nice and definitely saved me time. The quality of writing from the AI is really good.

Really like this app!

It provides a simple approach to writing release notes. The fact that you're creating the release notes directly in Jira instead of having to jump to a 3rd party site is great, as it takes less than 15 minutes from the moment you install the app to the moment you're publishing your first release note.

The team behind the app is great, and in the few months we've used Released there has been a constant flow of useful updates to make the experience even better.

Can't recommend it enough, if you need a lightweight yet extremely useful app for creating, managing and releas

Released's AI features and custom prompts work surprisingly well. With just a few tweaks, tailoring the prompt to our issue descriptions, we were able to get really good results. But the best part is the tight integration with Jira. Preparing a product update literally takes a couple of clicks when using the new templates. Love it.

The Released app for Jira is a great tool that has significantly transformed our approach to managing release notes and maintaining effective communication across teams. Its impact on our workflow has been very positive. The app introduces a new and efficient method for handling release notes, making it easier to track changes and updates. One of the app's best features is its easy setup process, making it accessible even for those who are not admins. 

We are integrating the Released app's embed feature into our Confluence apps. This seems particularly advantageous for our intranet use case,
Very good app, with a good product team listening for customer suggestions.
Love the simplicity and effectiveness of the app. Well thought out and implemented.

We use Released to publish Multiplier's in-app changelog and on our website. 

The app was super quick to get started with (we switched from a competitor) and we've been thoroughly impressed by how easy it is to generate high quality release notes from our Jira Backlog.

I wholeheartedly recommend this app. We are employing it to showcase in-app changelogs, which results in a stunning and rejuvenating appearance. Additionally, it's worth mentioning that Jens, an Ex-Atlassian, is at the helm, ensuring a high level of expertise and competence in its development.
Released is a game-changer for app developers! It's quick to set up, and the app exudes a super high-quality feel. I absolutely recommend it to anyone developing software.

Super easy set-up even for non-dev people, very straight-forward user experience and great overall app. AI works well, even if you haven't put in a lot of description text in the issues. And if it doesn't hit the spot exactly, it's still a great first draft to elaborate on. Super helpful!

After using this app, writing release notes has become much simpler! I can easily control it from my Jira project and synchronize all of the information on our website and documentation. With its neat UI and AI-powered capabilities, you won't be disappointed. Give it a try!
This app is a time saver and is free for small teams like mine. I will keep using it for sure. I am programmer and I hate wasting time on writing freestyle texts like release notes :P
Being able to create something I actually dare put on my website, just out of my existing Jira issues and almost zero effort, is mind-blowing. Great job!

As a startup, we ship early and often! But keeping customers in the loop on all the awesome new stuff isn't easy. And writing release notes was usually among the action items I would continuously de-prioritize. Released changed this for me by effortlessly generating release notes straight from Jira tickets with the power of generative AI. I've been playing around with their product for a while now and love how seamless it is. No copy & paste nightmare, no complicated set-up, no writer's block!

Keep up the great work, team!

Our development team is constantly pushing code. As a result, we struggled with keeping up with release notes of changes that are happening constantly. Our customers want to be on the know of what new features or bug fixes we pushed out. Now, at a press of a button, with the help of AI powered notes, we can generate release notes and post them to all our channels easily.

As someone who values efficiency and apps that save me time, I can only recommend Released. It has transformed how I can create release notes by seamlessly integrating with Jira. It's like having an assistant who quickly turns our tickets into great first drafts for release notes and change log entries. It's a real time-saver, easily 10 times faster than starting from scratch and very easy to use. It doesn't have all the bells and whistles yet, but the core experience is spot-on, and that's what's most important to me. Give it a go. You won't be disappointed.
